semantic.justification: TaskSGE6BG implements controlled React/Tailwind Calc presenters for native grid,input-window and sheet-tab responsibilities. They consume actual ScViewData/ScMarkData and controller display/input projections,never a second cell,selection or draft model. The grid paints a bounded viewport on a full-domain scroll canvas,with logical ARIA coordinates,source active/marked cell state,headers,inline edit focus and unchanged keyboard/pointer/IME intents. Input-window function/sum/equals and OK/cancel composition follows native mode switching. Tabs read actual sheet names and selected/active identities. Native commands,formatting,draft state and navigation stay with their controllers. Exact Writer toolbar-button styles are extracted into framework/browser/presentation/office-control-styles.ts and shared by Writer/Calc; global fonts,slate/indigo palette,Tailwind,rounded states and Lucide icons are reused. This task implements presentation contracts,not a registered production Calc module or complete editable workbench. TaskBG0GG5 ports actual ScUndoSetCell maPos/maOldValue/maNewValue move ownership,represented SetValue,GetComment and getAffectedRange at native source/header boundaries. ScCellValue.release transfers real formulas without cloning and copies literal strings before clearing ownership. Shared SfxListUndoAction exposes native inherited SfxUndoArray.GetUndoAction forward-storage access. The browser current plain-input decoder prepares actual native cell/formula owners at each selected sheet position before writes;source selected-mark iteration uses existing EnterListAction/LeaveListAction so one user input creates one compound action. Undo reverses children,Redo forwards them;browser focus follows the last executed native affected range. Native selected sheets render Writer indigo/slate selection tokens while active state remains distinct. Full ScSimpleUndo,ScDocFunc/ScViewFunc,ScUndoEnterData raw-string redo,formatter/format attributes,change tracking,sheet views,spill/VCL services remain unported;no facade or injected fake provider is introduced.
